diagnosis.explanation: uv --emit-index-url serializes the default PyPI index but does not serialize the package-level explicit PyTorch source declared through tool.uv.sources. The resulting file is therefore insufficient as an independent source-routing contract.

decision: Preserve and reject the source-aware export root. Replace the failed all-in-one index serialization assumption with an offline registry-routing split: non-torch locked requirements route only to PyPI, and locked torch requirements route only to the official PyTorch CPU index.
next_gate: Freeze an offline, byte-traceable requirements split whose two source routes reconstruct the accepted dependency body and retain all 208 requirement heads; no wheel acquisition is authorized yet.
prohibited_actions: editing, deleting, or relabeling the rejected root or its partial exports
treating the partial export as a complete wheelhouse acquisition input
using an unrestricted extra-index fallback for every dependency
downloading wheels, installing packages, changing torch builds, or starting numerical work from this failure
